templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to a services agreement covering the provider's use of AI services, including treatment of customer input and output and restrictions on training models with customer data.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a service provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information on behalf of a covered entity.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability, and term and termination.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Terms governing the processing of personal data by a provider on behalf of a customer, including GDPR-style processor obligations, subprocessors, security, and international transfers.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early-stage customers who get access to a product in development in exchange for providing feedback to the provider.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information while evaluating or pursuing a business relationship.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Cover page for the mutual NDA where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, term, governing law, and signatures; incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services and deliver work product under statements of work.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for business partnerships such as referral, reseller, or co-marketing arrangements, covering cooperation, trademarks, payments, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a limited-time trial or pilot of a product before the customer commits to a full commercial agreement.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service level commitments for a cloud service, including uptime targets, support response times, and service credits for failures to meet them.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing installable or on-premise software, covering license scope, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, and liability.
